procedures.title: FC ice maker test mode & FBEC/FBEB faults

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics active. Use ▲/▼ to reach the test number for this procedure; Freezer to enter.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Navigate with temperature up/down arrows.

steps.title: Enter FC ice maker test mode
steps.body: Empty ice tray. Lock button 3 sec. Both RC and FC doors open — hold Freezer + Mode 3 sec. Freezer Ice Off light blinks.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Empty ice tray. Lock button 3 sec. Both RC and FC doors open — hold Freezer + Mode 3 sec. Freezer Ice Off light blinks.

steps.title: Run IM test cycle
steps.body: IM initializes, harvests, then fills with water. Listen for fill — no error code if fill fails.
steps.sourceExcerpt: IM initializes, harvests, then fills with water. Listen for fill — no error code if fill fails.

steps.title: Ice maker test result
steps.body: Did test complete without FBEC/FBEB error on display?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Did test complete without FBEC/FBEB error on display?

steps.title: Verify IM voltages during harvest
steps.body: CN2-1 A+ to CN2-2 A- = 12.7 VDC motor; CN2-6 CE/SW to CN2-7 GND = 5 VDC switch.
steps.sourceExcerpt: CN2-1 A+ to CN2-2 A- = 12.7 VDC motor; CN2-6 CE/SW to CN2-7 GND = 5 VDC switch.

steps.title: Check tray thermistor
steps.body: Run service test 07 for tray thermistor. FBEB = tray thermistor fault.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run service test 07 for tray thermistor. FBEB = tray thermistor fault.
